import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.PID
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Localization
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Integer
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.GaussLemma
namespace Assessment190Isolated
#check_failure Roth.Θ_le_of_forall_index_le
#check @csSup_le
#check @Real.sSup_le
#check @Set.forall_mem_image2
theorem proof1 {α : Type*} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {c : α}
    (hs : s.Nonempty) (hc : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ c) : sSup s ≤ c := csSup_le hs hc
theorem proof2 {s : Set ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ c) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) :
    sSup s ≤ c := Real.sSup_le hc hc0
theorem proof3 {α β γ : Type*} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice γ] (f : α → β → γ)
    {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {c : γ} (hst : (Set.image2 f s t).Nonempty)
    (hc : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ t, f a b ≤ c) : sSup (Set.image2 f s t) ≤ c :=
  csSup_le hst (Set.forall_mem_image2.mpr hc)
#print axioms proof1
#print axioms proof2
#print axioms proof3
end Assessment190Isolated
